hero.title_html:
Qualified Practitioners
for Children Who Deserve Early Intervention
hero.paragraph: We train behavior specialists able to deliver effective, evidence-based interventions for children with autism spectrum disorder and developmental disabilities — through internationally aligned programs supervised by certified behavior analysts.

about.title: Training built on scientific foundations
about.lead: ABA Demy is an Arabic-language platform specialized in Applied Behavior Analysis, combining specialized training, scientific resources, and a professional community — to meet practitioners' needs and support families with services and consultations grounded in best practice.
about.paragraph: Our model combines live theoretical instruction, hands-on supervision, and continuous professional assessment in line with international standards. It is delivered by internationally certified Syrian experts who bring global expertise and adapt it to the local Syrian context.

philosophy.title_html:
Knowledge doesn't end at learning..
it begins at application

items.name: Applied Behavior Analysis Technician
items.description: The entry professional level for delivering direct behavioral interventions to children. Includes 40 hours of theory and 15 hours of supervised practice with skill application, case analysis, and direct mentoring.

items.name: Qualified Applied Behavior Analysis Specialist
items.description: An advanced professional program for practitioners who want to deepen their knowledge and skills in Applied Behavior Analysis and move to a higher tier of professional competency under recognized frameworks.

why.title: Balancing international standards with local reality

items.title: International alignment
items.description: Programs built on the requirements of international ABA credentialing bodies.

items.title: Certified supervision
items.description: Delivered under a certified behavior analyst (BCBA) and a certified autism supervisor (QASP).

items.title: Arabic content
items.description: The first structured program available in Arabic at a cost suited to the Syrian context.

items.title: Flexible learning
items.description: Live online theory with practical supervision and continuous assessment.

origin.title: A story that began from a real need

items.label: The Reality
items.text: Amid rising demand for evidence-based interventions in Syria, there is a clear shortage of specialized training, Arabic-language resources, and professional services that practitioners and families need.

items.label: The Challenge
items.text: Practitioners faced limited opportunities for professional development and specialized qualification, while families struggled to access professional services to support their children with developmental disabilities early on.

items.label: This Is Where ABA Demy Began
items.text: To become one of the first specialized platforms in Syria, bringing together specialized training, educational resources, professional supervision, and family support services.
